skeptic.objection: This is not vacant industrial land. The county address-point layer, queried by this parcel id, returns 96 active main addresses on the parcel, 2848 Veterans St itself classed Residential - Single Structure: an occupied manufactured-home community, so buying it means closing a lived-in community and relocating residents. The screener's MI code is East Point's M-I Medical Institutional district, not industrial, and the city has since approved a use permit for 138 assisted senior living units in M-I on Norman Berry Drive parcels that lie within 1,500 ft of this site. East Point also treats a warehouse within 5,280 ft of residential property as needing a variance even in its I-1 Light Industrial district, and this parcel is surrounded by homes. The by_right entitlement and grade B rest on a misread zoning code.
